note: Consolidated MC-11 engineering, marine-operation, sourcing, commercial, legal, safety and security risk register. Every mitigation is PROPOSED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no risk is closed. Likelihood/impact/evidenceStrength are engineering judgements over repository evidence, not measured probabilities.

risks.title: No physical prototype, so no electrical, thermal or EMC measurement exists
risks.description: No MAREA board exists. Power consumption, dissipation, transient behaviour, radiated/conducted emissions, isolation and EMC immunity are all unmeasured; every power budget in MC-11 is a candidate requirement.
risks.mitigation: Bench prototype under a separately authorised G4 plan; measurement-first design review before any freeze.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Authorise G4 prototype testing with a defined safe test plan and equipment.

risks.title: Marine DC transient and surge protection is designed but unvalidated
risks.description: Load dump, alternator transients, engine-start dips and charger noise are handled as candidate requirements only; no TVS/fuse coordination has been measured on a marine harness.
risks.mitigation: Candidate protection matrix plus transient test cases in the qualification plan.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Execute transient immunity tests on the first prototype (QUAL rows).

risks.title: Multiple marine networks joined in one gateway create ground-loop and isolation hazards
risks.description: HUB may connect NMEA 0183, NMEA 2000 and Ethernet simultaneously. Galvanic isolation, shield bonding and single-point grounding are candidate requirements; no measurement or network survey exists.
risks.mitigation: Isolation boundaries and interface protection matrix defined in D5; verify against real vessel wiring before freeze.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Vessel survey and bench isolation test under G4/G5 authorisation.

risks.title: Sealed-enclosure thermal design unverified
risks.description: A sun-exposed, sealed marine enclosure with an application processor and cellular modem has no verified thermal path. Throttling or over-temperature shutdown could disable monitoring.
risks.mitigation: Thermal test cases at maximum ambient and worst-case radio duty cycle in the qualification plan.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Run temperature-rise and soak tests on the first prototype.

risks.title: Firmware update, rollback and recovery are designed but never executed
risks.description: A/B update, signed images and recovery boot are candidate mechanisms only. A failed update on an unattended vessel could strand the device.
risks.mitigation: Update-state machine and recovery requirement set in D27; power-loss update tests in the qualification plan.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Execute interrupted-update and rollback tests once hardware exists.

risks.title: Zero tested compatibility rows
risks.description: All 29 compatibility rows are DOCUMENTED_INTERFACE, PROPOSED, ASSUMED, TEST_REQUIRED or BLOCKED. No third-party device, firmware or adapter combination has been tested.
risks.mitigation: Compatibility matrix with required test equipment and a recorded-device-test gate before any published statement.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Authorise bench interoperability testing with named devices and firmware versions.

risks.title: DISPLAY panel has a single verified source
risks.description: Only one display module could be verified in this session; no second source was identified. A single-source sunlight-readable panel is a schedule and cost risk.
risks.mitigation: Require a qualified second panel before design freeze; record optical and thermal equivalence criteria.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Public-source second-source search and sample comparison (requires G2 authorisation).

risks.title: Sunlight readability, contrast and wet/gloved usability are unproven
risks.description: Brightness, optical bonding, AR coating and glove/wet touch performance are candidate requirements. No photometric or human-factors test exists.
risks.mitigation: Photometric and usability test cases with acceptance criteria in the qualification plan.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Bench photometry and a structured usability protocol once a panel and housing exist.

risks.title: SENSE measurement accuracy is entirely unmeasured
risks.description: Battery current/voltage, bilge state, temperature/humidity and motion accuracy claims are not made and cannot be made; no calibration has been performed.
risks.mitigation: Calibration and accuracy plan with acceptance criteria; never publish an accuracy figure before testing.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Reference-instrument comparison under G4 authorisation.

risks.title: Salt, humidity and condensation behaviour unverified
risks.description: No salt-fog, damp-heat or condensation test has been run; enclosure, gasket, vent and connector choices are candidates only.
risks.mitigation: Environmental qualification plan with candidate IEC 60945 / IEC 60529 requirements and no rating claim.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Accredited salt-fog, damp-heat and ingress tests once a prototype exists.

risks.title: Vibration and mechanical shock unverified
risks.description: Connector retention, mounting and solder-joint fatigue under engine/hull vibration are untested; consumer modules use connectors that may not survive.
risks.mitigation: Vibration and shock test cases with candidate marine acceptance criteria.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Shock and vibration testing plus a connector-retention review at DFM stage.

risks.title: Installation error and installer competence
risks.description: Self-install boundaries, wiring guidance and commissioning records are defined commercially but not validated with installers. Miswiring a marine DC bus can damage equipment or create a fire risk.
risks.mitigation: Installer-assisted classification, documented commissioning checklist and fail-safe wiring requirements.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Installer validation is a customer-research dependency (MC-10 blocked) plus a G5 integration test.

risks.title: WATCH may drain the battery it monitors
risks.description: Quiescent and average consumption are unknown. A monitoring device that flattens the battery it protects is a product-defeating failure mode; deep-discharge protection and low-power modes are candidate requirements only.
risks.mitigation: Measurable battery-drain budget, configurable low-power modes and low-voltage cut-off requirement in D5/D8.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Measure sleep and transmit current on hardware; long-duration soak test.

risks.title: Alert delivery cannot be guaranteed and may fail silently
risks.description: The alert chain depends on vessel power, cellular coverage, cloud availability and the customer's channel. No delivery guarantee is made or possible; failure detection may itself fail.
risks.mitigation: Local buffering, retry, heartbeat and explicit non-guarantee wording; delivery telemetry with honest states.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Field-style coverage-loss test under G4/G5; define the minimum viable alert contract with MC-10 customer evidence.

risks.title: The u-blox MAX-M10 GNSS family is end-of-life
risks.description: All three registered MAX-M10 variants are EOL; the inherited GNSS assumption is not sourceable for a production programme.
risks.mitigation: Select a replacement GNSS module with a published longevity commitment before design freeze.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Second-source GNSS search and lifecycle confirmation with the manufacturer (requires G2).

risks.title: Secure element ATECC608B is NRND
risks.description: The candidate root of trust is not recommended for new designs, which undermines a multi-year device-identity and provisioning strategy.
risks.mitigation: Evaluate a current secure element / SoC trust root with a published lifecycle and key-provisioning service.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Security-part shortlist with manufacturer lifecycle statements (requires G2 for confirmation).

risks.title: Serial EEPROM AT24CS32 is NRND
risks.description: A minor but real lifecycle risk for the board identity/config store.
risks.mitigation: Replace with an active equivalent at schematic freeze.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Confirm replacement part lifecycle from the manufacturer page.

risks.title: Compute-module lifecycle and availability are consumer-grade
risks.description: The candidate CM4 module has unknown lifecycle status in this session, no verified orderable code and no long-term supply commitment; a consumer compute module can change without notice.
risks.mitigation: Compare an industrial SOM with a published 10-year lifecycle before freezing the HUB compute choice.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Confirm lifecycle and industrial variants with the manufacturer (G2).

risks.title: Enclosure is a single-source, unverified mechanical part
risks.description: The candidate IP-rated enclosure has unknown lifecycle and no verified second source; the mechanical design depends on it.
risks.mitigation: Second enclosure source or a tooling decision before mechanical freeze.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Mechanical sourcing review with drawings and sealing specification (G2/G3).

risks.title: Counterfeit and unauthorised-channel exposure
risks.description: Most parts were observed only on manufacturer pages; authorised-distributor availability, traceability and certificate of conformity are unverified. Grey-market parts are a real marine-electronics hazard.
risks.mitigation: Procure only through authorised distributors with traceability; incoming inspection and authenticity checks in the quality plan.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Define the approved-supplier list and incoming-inspection rules before any purchase (G2/G3).

risks.title: USD-denominated manufacturer list prices and FX exposure
risks.description: 36 of 42 observed prices are USD manufacturer list prices with unknown VAT, and no observed EUR/USD rate was confirmed; landed cost and currency exposure are unknown.
risks.mitigation: Record a real FX rate source or label the conversion as an explicit assumption; re-price at quotation time.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Obtain real quotations in EUR with Incoterms (G2/G3).

risks.title: No customer evidence exists
risks.description: MC-10 executed zero interviews and zero price responses. Demand, willingness to pay, required sensor set, tolerable price band and channel terms are all unvalidated. MC-11 hardware choices therefore rest on internal judgement only.
risks.mitigation: Do not freeze any architecture or order hardware before customer discovery; carry the dependency explicitly into MC-12.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Unblock AUTH-MC10-001 fieldwork or formally accept a hardware-first risk with its cost exposure.

risks.title: BOM cost may exceed the commercial price hypotheses
risks.description: Price hypotheses remain HYPOTHESIS_UNAPPROVED and the BOM is incomplete because many inputs are unknown. A positive contribution margin is not established for any family.
risks.mitigation: Keep totals INCOMPLETE, publish only ranges with explicit unknowns and feed MC-12 with per-line confidence.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Real quotations (G2/G3) and MC-12 contribution analysis; no price approval in MC-11.

risks.title: Conformity testing and certification cost/schedule are unknown
risks.description: No laboratory quotation exists; EMC, radio and ingress campaigns are BUDGETARY_INDICATION or UNKNOWN. Certification can cost more than the hardware engineering for a low-volume product.
risks.mitigation: Staged conformity gates C0–C9 and a laboratory RFQ package that is prepared but not sent.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Request real laboratory quotations after G2 authorisation; no guarantee may be quoted before that.

risks.title: Low volume cannot amortise NRE, tooling and certification
risks.description: A marine niche product may sell in tens of units; enclosure tooling, PCB NRE, certification and firmware maintenance then dominate unit economics.
risks.mitigation: Prefer enclosure platforms and shared gateway compute; model 1/10/100/500/1000 volumes explicitly.
risks.nextVerificationAction: MC-12 volume-scenario economics with real quotation inputs.

risks.title: Warranty and RMA burden is undetermined
risks.description: No field-failure data, no warranty duration and no RMA logistics exist; a marine repair can cost more than the product.
risks.mitigation: RMA model, failure classification and spare-parts strategy; no warranty promise before evidence.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Define service levels after MC-10 installer/owner validation.

risks.title: MAREA trademark clearance NOT_GRANTED
risks.description: The brand is proposed only; a material conflict was indicated at MC-03. No public brand use or registered-mark claim is authorised.
risks.mitigation: Keep INTERNAL_ONLY brand status; do not publish or file without specialist clearance.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Specialist trademark clearance (DEC-01) remains an external dependency.

risks.title: OPEN-MARINE source IP NOT_CLEARED
risks.description: No licence grants MAREA the right to ship OPEN-MARINE-derived code or firmware. Copying code into the commercial repository is prohibited.
risks.mitigation: Read-only reference; independent re-implementation from specifications; licence review before any reuse.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Complete rights assessment with the rights holder; do not reuse code meanwhile.

risks.title: No technical file and no conformity evidence for any configuration
risks.description: 18 conformity blockers (8 CRITICAL) remain open, including undetermined manufacturer identity, no technical file, no test evidence and an unfrozen configuration.
risks.mitigation: Applicability matrix, technical-file map and staged gates C0–C9.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Freeze configuration, then build the technical file and obtain real test evidence (G6).

risks.title: NMEA licensing and certification not obtained
risks.description: No NMEA membership, licence, manufacturer code or product certification exists; zero compatibility rows are tested. Any NMEA capability claim is prohibited.
risks.mitigation: Six-question separation in D25 with prohibited-claim list and certification roadmap.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Decide whether to implement NMEA 2000 at all, then license and certify (external, funded, G6).

risks.title: Cyber Resilience Act obligations apply and are not met
risks.description: CRA reporting obligations are already in force (11 September 2026) and main obligations apply from 11 December 2027. Product classification and the manufacturer role are undetermined; no vulnerability handling, SBOM process or support period exists.
risks.mitigation: CRA requirement mapping in D27/D23 as an input, with qualified legal review and an SBOM/vulnerability process design.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Legal classification review and an operational security-process plan before any market placement.

risks.title: Legal manufacturer and economic operator identity undetermined
risks.description: It is unverified whether EMBARCARTE is the manufacturer, importer, distributor or own-brand seller of each candidate product. Obligations follow that role.
risks.mitigation: Record role as UNDETERMINED in every conformity row; require a contractual/legal decision before technical file work.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Legal entity, supplier contract and own-brand analysis (external legal input).

risks.title: Product liability and insurance position not established
risks.description: Marine electronics can contribute to vessel damage or personal injury. No liability insurance, contractual limitation or safety case exists; PILOT is safety-blocked.
risks.mitigation: Keep PILOT blocked, no control function, no guaranteed alert, and explicit disclaimers with installer-facing limits.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Legal and insurance review before any commercial release.

risks.title: PILOT safety gate remains closed and no control path is authorised
risks.description: Control authority, actuator suitability, E-stop, redundant feedback and vessel variation are documented as an outline only. Any actuator implementation would be a safety-critical programme requiring qualified engineering and insurance.
risks.mitigation: PILOT_SAFETY_GATE=BLOCKED; no motor/steering control designed or implemented; disposition DEFER_SAFETY_CRITICAL_DEVELOPMENT.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Separate funded safety programme with qualified engineering; not an MC-11 action.

risks.title: AIS receive data may be misread and transmission is prohibited
risks.description: AIS targets are not a collision-avoidance system and may be stale or incomplete. Any AIS transmitter development would add spectrum, approval and liability obligations.
risks.mitigation: Explicit receive-only disclaimer; transmitter development permanently prohibited in MC-11 scope.
risks.nextVerificationAction: If ever proposed, a separate RED/maritime type-approval programme would be required.

risks.title: Unsigned or non-recoverable firmware update path
risks.description: If signed updates and rollback protection are not implemented, a compromised or malformed image can brick an unattended device or become a persistent foothold.
risks.mitigation: Signed-image chain, rollback protection and A/B recovery as MUST requirements in D27.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Implement and test the update chain on hardware before any field deployment.

risks.title: Key provisioning strategy depends on an NRND secure element
risks.description: Device identity and key storage rest on a candidate secure element that is NRND; provisioning at manufacture, key rotation and ownership transfer are undesigned.
risks.mitigation: Key hierarchy and provisioning design independent of a single part; replacement of the NRND element.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Select a current trust root and validate provisioning in factory-test design.

risks.title: Vulnerability handling and support period undefined
risks.description: No support-period commitment, CVE intake, disclosure policy or patch SLA exists; CRA obligations assume one exists by market placement.
risks.mitigation: Support-period and vulnerability-handling requirement set in D27 as a pre-market gate.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Operating model and funding decision for a multi-year firmware maintenance programme.

risks.title: Cloud/connected-device data protection roles undesigned
risks.description: No data controller is designated, no processor agreement exists and no data-residency or deletion design is approved for a connected device and its cloud service.
risks.mitigation: Designate roles and data flows; local-first behaviour and offline function independence as requirements.
risks.nextVerificationAction: Legal/privacy design before any pilot or customer data collection.
